propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) triggers rollback that deletes the successfully-created Jira issue, destroying recoverable work
A keyed-pending binding is recorded before identity writes but survives rollback unbound, causing the local ticket to be permanently stranded across retries
The recover_pending keyed branch exists to retro-attach labels and properties deterministically without search, making rollback deletion redundant

Jira rejects field writes with misleading screen-related messages in at least three distinct failure modes: missing screen configuration, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or malformed field values

The proposed fix is to stop deleting on identity write failures, leave the binding keyed-pending for recover_pending to complete, and declare labels as a required screen configuration requirement rather than attempting pre-flight field discovery
